stories.title: Paralemmin-2 is a membrane-anchored cytoskeletal constituent of Axon Initial Segments and nodes of Ranvier
stories.body: The axon initial segment (AIS) and nodes of Ranvier (NoR) are essential for action potential initiation and propagation. They share many features of their molecular architecture, and their assembly mechanisms converge on the membrane-associated periodic skeleton (MPS). stories.title: The Adhesion GPCR Flamingo-Like 1 (FMIL-1) Directs Synapse Formation in a Nociceptive Circuit
stories.body: The species-specific anatomy of nervous systems suggests that circuit architecture is largely encoded by genetic blueprints.
